reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,000.0, 346.4 points under spot. This is the same floor endday published and it has now survived a second full session untested - the lowest settled hourly close since the endday mark is 77,216.7 at 05:00Z, 216.7 points clear, and the lowest wick is 77,171.9. Losing it on a settled close breaks the compression downward and hands price to the 76,875 to 77,125 band, where 1,868,787 USD of long liquidations were filled in the current measured window. Below that the next measured reference is 76,001.0, the CPI flush low, and the weekend book between the two is thin.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,708.8, the 4H EMA20, 362.4 points over spot. The gate is deliberately set above the 1H EMA50 at 77,546.7 and above the 77,375 to 77,625 short-liquidation band rather than at the 77,381.2 box high: the box high is only 34.8 points over spot and a gate that close is a coin flip on noise, which is this desk's most-repeated logged mistake. Reclaiming the 4H EMA20 on a settled close is the first event that would put price back above an average it has been under since 08 September, and it is also the level that invalidates tonight's futures short.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from endday's REDUCE to HOLD on the spot core, and the active stance moves into futures instead. Endday's REDUCE was a response to its own reduce gate firing three times; overnight neither of the gates it published fired. The 77,000.0 reduce gate held with 216.7 points to spare on settled closes and the 77,594.3 add gate missed by 293.9 points on closes and 213.1 on the high. Price spent the entire session inside a 209.3-point box, 0.27 percent wide against a daily ATR of 2,191.79 - a compression of roughly one tenth of a normal day's range. There is nothing for the spot core to react to, so it holds. What HAS changed is under the surface, and it is the reason the tilt stays bearish and why the trade tonight is a short rather than another spot tranche. Swap open interest has turned back up, 2,122,897,548 USD against endday's 2,096,470,458, plus 1.26 percent, ending a seventeen-hour drain; aggregate BTC open interest rose from 2,788,909,773 USD at 00:00Z to 2,821,876,881 at 07:00Z, plus 1.18 percent, while price moved 0.15 percent. Funding has gone from plus 0.0000237948 to plus 0.0000925535, near four times higher, so longs are paying more to hold. And the OKX long/short account ratio printed 1.64 at the 07:00Z bar, flat at 1.64 for six straight hours and a NEW high above endday's 1.63 and midnight-before's 1.61. Leverage is rebuilding, one-sided long, into a tightening range with 14.3 times more measured long-side fuel below price than short-side fuel above it. Spot is also sitting 1.1 points above the 1H EMA20 at 77,346.4 inside a structure that is below the 1H EMA50, EMA100 and EMA200 - a clean mean-reversion tag in a downtrend. Holding the core and selling that tag with a defined stop expresses the read honestly without churning the long-term book endday just trimmed.

liquidation.note: 76,875 to 77,125 bucket. 1,868,787 USD of filled long liquidations, 78.0 percent of the entire measured window and the densest cluster of the week. This is realised fuel - leverage already cleared - so it marks where forced selling has repeatedly been found, not resting stops waiting to be run.

77,125 to 77,375 bucket, 250,833 USD, almost all long-side and including the newest fill in the window at 77,219.9. It brackets spot from just underneath and is the reason the freshness guard passes: the feed's newest print sits 126.5 points from current price.
76,625 to 76,875 bucket, 121,890 USD long-side. Overlaps yesterday's 76,880.1 session low, which is why that low is carried as a support reference rather than dropped.

77,375 to 77,625 bucket, 155,412 USD. This single band is essentially the WHOLE short side of the window - measured short-side total is 156,889 USD. It sits between the 1H EMA50 at 77,546.7 and tonight's futures stop at 77,620.0, which is why the stop is placed above it rather than inside it.

liquidityMagnet.note: An honest caveat has to lead here. The 100-record buffer is 96 percent the SAME window endday read: only 2 new liquidations totalling 819 USD have printed since the 00:41Z endday mark, and the newest is 3 hours 47 minutes old. That near-zero print rate is itself the signal - it is what a genuine compression looks like, nobody is being forced out in either direction - but it means the band geography below has not been re-tested tonight and should be treated as carried evidence, not fresh evidence. What it still establishes is the asymmetry: 2,240,033 USD long-side against 156,889 USD short-side, 14.3 to 1, with every long band under price and the entire short side in one band overhead. Pull reads down on that imbalance, reinforced by the account ratio at a new high of 1.64 and funding turning positive, not on any new flow tonight.

calibration.rollingRecord: Last 12 resolved sessions: directional call correct 6 of 12. Gate behaviour over the same window: 3 of 11 published reduce gates fired, 5 of 11 add gates fired. Endday is the first session in five where NEITHER gate fired - and it is also the first in five where the report's headline call, range, was the outcome.
calibration.note: Endday published reduce at a settled 1H close below 77,000.0 and add at a settled 1H close above 77,594.3. NEITHER fired. The lowest settled hourly close since the 00:41Z mark was 77,216.7 at 05:00Z, holding 216.7 points above the reduce gate, and the lowest wick 77,171.9 held 171.9 above it. The highest settled close was 77,300.4 at 06:00Z, short of the add gate by 293.9 points, and the session high of 77,381.2 missed by 213.1. The 76,001.0 invalidation was never remotely approached - the low held 1,170.9 points above it - and the RECOMMENDED resting stop at 76,740.0 would not have filled, clearing the session low by 431.9 points. That is the seventh time in eight sessions that the stop decision, whichever way it went, cost nothing. Discretionary: endday REDUCED 12 percent of the spot core at 77,270.0 and spot marks 77,346.4, so the sold slice is 76.4 points and 0.10 percent offside, roughly minus 0.02 USDT - noise. The honest grade is that endday got the DIRECTION category right and the tilt wrong-but-harmless: it called range at 42 percent and the session delivered a 209.3-point box, while the bearish tilt at 31 percent versus bullish at 27 did not pay. More useful than the score is the correction it forces on the ETF read - endday recorded 11 September as a plus 6.0 partial and it settled at minus 13.2, which extends the negative streak to four sessions rather than ending it at three.
